name: get_open_file_name_import_provider
description: COMDLG32!GetOpenFileNameA import provider used by CZRecoilFrame::OnOpenFileDialog.
known_limits: Imported runtime provider: Binary Ninja shows a non-authored import thunk jmp through COMDLG32!GetOpenFileNameA at 0x4c637c.
The native smoke exercises the host COMDLG32 provider with an invalid OPENFILENAMEA size so the call returns without opening a dialog.
